title: Campaign story overview
summary: After a global energy crisis enables the Federation of the Americas to rise, the Federation turns the U.S. ODIN orbital-defense system against the United States. Ten years later, brothers Logan and Hesh Walker fight alongside the elite Ghosts under their father Elias. Their central enemy is Gabriel Rorke, a former Ghost commander who was abandoned during a disastrous Caracas operation, captured, and turned by the Federation. The Ghosts hunt Rorke while sabotaging Federation infrastructure and eventually discover LOKI, a Federation orbital kinetic-weapon platform. During the final American counteroffensive, U.S. forces seize LOKI and use it against Federation targets. Logan and Hesh attack Rorke aboard a train and believe they have killed him, but he survives and captures Logan, ending the campaign on a cliffhanger.

title: Extinction story overview
summary: Extinction follows a separate Cryptid-focused storyline. Point of Contact begins the outbreak response; Nightfall reveals the secret research program around David Archer and Samantha Cross; Mayday continues the pursuit aboard the Stormbreaker and expands the Medusa/Cortex plot; Awakening takes the team into an Ancestor Ark beneath Ball's Pyramid; and Exodus concludes the main Ghosts Extinction arc around the Medusa Device, Cryptid Ancestors, and humanity's survival effort.
